items.title: AI SEO Training: How to Learn AI SEO in 2026 (Free and Paid)
items.content:
The best AI SEO training teaches you a working system — not just tools — for ranking in Google and getting cited in AI answers. I’ve spent 10+ years in SEO and now rank new pages within hours using AI, and in the video below I show how I rank new AI keywords in 24 hours with Claude. Here’s what good AI SEO training covers, and the free and paid ways to learn it with me.

Key takeaways

- Good AI SEO training covers keywords, content, GEO, links and AI agents.

- Start free with AI Money Lab and my YouTube tutorials.

- Get hands-on help in the SEO Elite Circle or the AI Profit Boardroom.

- Want it done for you? Book a free SEO strategy session.

## What AI SEO training should teach

- Fresh-first keyword research — find new and trending topics before competitors, and check what you already rank for.

- AI-assisted content — research, outline and draft with Claude and other models, then edit for real expertise.

- On-page structure — answer-first intros, clear headings, tables, FAQs and schema.

- GEO and AEO — structuring pages so ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google’s AI Overviews quote you.

- Links and authority — earned, relevant backlinks, the foundation of my agency.

- Indexing and tracking — getting pages found fast and measuring clicks in Search Console.

- AI agents for SEO — Hermes, Claude and an Agent OS to automate research, writing and publishing.

## AI SEO training options with Julian Goldie

Prefer it mapped 1-on-1 first? Book a free strategy session and we’ll plan it for your exact situation.

Join the AI Profit Boardroom →Book a Free Strategy Session →

## Free AI SEO training

You can learn a lot without paying anything. My YouTube channel has daily AI SEO tutorials with real Search Console data, and the free AI Money Lab community has AI courses, prompts and ready-made agents. Grab 200+ free AI SEO prompts and the free Link Building Mastery book too.

## Paid AI SEO training: SEO Elite Circle vs AI Profit Boardroom

Choose the SEO Elite Circle if SEO is your main goal: weekly hot-seat calls where we work on your actual site, direct access to me, and the SOPs my agency uses. Choose the AI Profit Boardroom if you want AI SEO plus AI automation and agents more broadly: four live coaching calls a week, daily Q&A, full courses and the Agent OS.

## My AI SEO system in five steps

- Find fresh keywords — new tools, updates and trends, plus gaps where you have impressions but no page.

- Research properly — primary sources, real facts, your own experience and video.

- Write answer-first — the keyword and the answer in the first line, clear headings, tables and FAQs.

- Publish and index fast — then interlink with your related pages.

- Measure and update — check clicks, refresh winners and fix pages that stall.

That’s the system behind results I’ve shown on camera, like a site going from zero to 1,300 clicks a day and 90,000 AI mentions in 90 days.

## Mistakes AI SEO training should fix

- Publishing thin AI content — volume without research doesn’t rank for long.

- Ignoring links — authority still matters, in Google and in AI answers.

- Chasing tools instead of building a repeatable process.

- Never updating — fast-moving topics need regular refreshes.

- Not tracking results — if you don’t measure clicks, you can’t improve.

## Who AI SEO training is for

Business owners who want more customers from search, freelancers and agencies who want to deliver faster, and creators who want their content found in Google and AI answers. You don’t need to be technical: if you can describe what you want, AI agents can do much of the heavy lifting.

## What my members learn first

Inside my communities, new members usually start with the same three wins. First, finding fresh keywords: new tools, updates and questions people are already searching, where competition is low. Second, publishing answer-first pages fast, with the keyword and the answer in the first line, a clear structure and an FAQ. Third, getting those pages indexed and interlinked with related content. Those three habits alone can move a site from no traffic to steady daily clicks, and they’re the foundation for everything else we teach.

From there, members add GEO techniques for AI answers, link building for authority, and AI agents that automate the research and drafting so they can publish consistently without burning out.

## Getting started with AI SEO training

Start free on YouTube and in AI Money Lab, join the SEO Elite Circle or the AI Profit Boardroom when you want live help, or book a free SEO strategy session if you’d rather my team handled it. Whichever you choose, good AI SEO training should leave you with a system you can run every week.

The most important thing is consistency. AI makes it possible to publish faster than ever, but the people who win are the ones who keep a weekly rhythm: find keywords, publish, index, measure, update. Training gives you the system and the accountability to stick with it, and that’s what turns a few early rankings into a site that grows every month.

Training on using AI to rank in Google and get cited in AI answers: keyword research, content, GEO, links, indexing and AI agents.

### Is there free AI SEO training?

Yes — Julian Goldie’s YouTube channel and the free AI Money Lab community.

### What is the best AI SEO training?

For hands-on SEO help, the SEO Elite Circle; for AI SEO plus AI automation, the AI Profit Boardroom.

### Do I need to be technical?

No — the training is built for business owners and beginners as well as SEOs.

### Can someone do AI SEO for me?

Yes — book a free SEO strategy session with Julian Goldie’s team.

Two ways I can help from here. Join the AI Profit Boardroom — it’s where your AI SEO plan gets built with 3,400+ members doing the same.

Or grab a free strategy session and bring your questions.
